overall.assessment: Podcast 'Mi u Bogu živimo, mičemo se i jesmo' predstavlja izniman primjer autentične digitalne evangelizacije koja uspješno premošćuje jaz između suvremenog digitalnog prostora i duboke franjevačke duhovnosti. Fokus na Lectio Divinu i kontemplaciju kao temelje kršćanskog života u potpunosti je usklađen s crkvenim naukom o važnosti Riječi Božje u svakodnevici. Inicijative poput 'e-duhovnih vježbi' pokazuju pastoralnu kreativnost u susretu s čovjekom na 'digitalnom kontinentu', ne gubeći pritom iz vida važnost fizičkog susreta i zajedništva.

sections.subtitle: Uvod u Ad Deum podcast i predstavljanje Fra Josipa Vlašića
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj predstavlja Fra Josipa Vlašića, ističući njegove uloge i povezanost s e-duhovnim vježbama i Masnom Lukom.
sections.content: U novoj epizodi Ad Deum podcasta, voditelj srdačno pozdravlja gledatelje i predstavlja posebnog gosta, **Fra Josipa Vlašića**. Fra Josip je poznat kao jedan od začetnika ideje e-duhovnih vježbi, kapelan samostalne kapelanije Svetog Ilije Proroka te voditelj Franjevačke kuće molitve u Masnoj Luci. Njegova prisutnost u podcastu obećava dubok uvid u duhovni život i molitvu, s posebnim naglaskom na jedinstveno okruženje Masne Luke.

magisterium.assessment: Uvodni dio je informativan i neutralan, te ne sadrži teološke tvrdnje koje bi bile u suprotnosti s naukom Crkve. Predstavljanje kapelana i franjevačke kuće molitve je u potpunosti u skladu s pastoralnom praksom.
magisterium.enrichment: Franjevačka duhovnost naglašava važnost molitve i služenja puku, što je temelj franjevačke karizme. E-duhovne vježbe predstavljaju suvremeni način evangelizacije koji Crkva potiče u digitalnom dobu kako bi doprla do vjernika.
magisterium.assessment_en: The introductory part is informative and neutral, and does not contain theological claims that would be in contradiction with the teaching of the Church. The presentation of the chaplain and the Franciscan house of prayer is fully in accordance with pastoral practice.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Franciscan spirituality emphasizes the importance of prayer and serving the people, which is the foundation of the Franciscan charism. E-spiritual exercises represent a contemporary way of evangelization which the Church encourages in the digital age in order to reach the faithful.

sections.subtitle_en: Introduction to the Ad Deum podcast and the introduction of Fra Josip Vlašić
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host introduces Fra Josip Vlašić, highlighting his roles and connection with e-duhovne vježbe and Masna Luka.
sections.content_en: In the new episode of the Ad Deum podcast, the host cordially greets the viewers and presents a special guest, **fra Josip Vlašić**. Fra Josip is known as one of the initiators of the idea of e-spiritual exercises, chaplain of the independent chaplaincy of Sveti Ilija Prorok and leader of the Franjevačka kuća molitve in Masna Luka. His presence in the podcast promises a deep insight into spiritual life and prayer, with a special emphasis on the unique environment of Masna Luka.

sections.subtitle: Život u planini i povijesni korijeni franjevaca u Masnoj Luci
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip objašnjava kako su franjevci slijedili svoj narod u planinu, brinući se za njihove duhovne potrebe.
sections.content: Fra Josip Vlašić opisuje život u planinskom okruženju **Blidinja**, **Čvrsnice** i **Vrane** kao povlasticu, ističući ljepotu parka prirode. Ipak, zime donose izazove poput neprohodnih putova, što zahtijeva spremnost i zalihe. Govoreći o povijesti, Fra Josip objašnjava kako su franjevci stigli u Masnu Luku. Ljudi iz **Hercegovine** su od svibnja do rujna dolazili sa svojim stadima na ispašu u planinu. Franjevci, poput pastira koji ne napušta svoje stado, slijedili su ih, pružajući duhovnu skrb. Profesori sa **Širokog Brijega** redovito su dolazili slaviti mise, krstiti, vjenčavati i pokapati. Tragedija Drugog svjetskog rata, s pokoljem u **Rami** i spaljivanjem franjevačke kuće 1942. godine, prekinula je njihovu stalnu prisutnost na četrdeset godina. Unatoč tome, franjevci su i dalje povremeno dolazili, služeći mise po grobljima. Ideja o povratku i izgradnji nove kuće rodila se u srcu **Fra Petra Krasića** krajem 70-ih i početkom 80-ih godina. Fra Petar je posvetio 40 godina života izgradnji kompleksa u Masnoj Luci, čiji su dominantni dijelovi danas crkva i velika Franjevačka kuća molitve.

magisterium.assessment: Opis povijesnog služenja franjevaca puku u planinskim krajevima je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkom misijskom i pastoralnom tradicijom. Briga za duhovne potrebe vjernika, uključujući sakramentalni život, temeljna je zadaća svećenika.
magisterium.enrichment: Franjevačka prisutnost među pukom, često u teškim uvjetima, odražava evanđeoski ideal pastira koji je blizak vjernicima. Povijesno gledano, franjevci su bili ključni u očuvanju vjere u krajevima gdje je redovita pastoralna skrb bila otežana.
magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the historical service of the Franciscans to the people in mountainous regions is fully aligned with Catholic missionary and pastoral tradition. Care for the spiritual needs of the faithful, including sacramental life, is the fundamental task of the priest.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Franciscan presence among the people, often in difficult conditions, reflects the evangelical ideal of a shepherd who is close to the faithful. Historically speaking, the Franciscans were key in preserving the faith in regions where regular pastoral care was made difficult.

sections.subtitle_en: Life in the mountain and historical roots of the Franciscans in Masna Luka
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip explains how the Franciscans followed their people into the mountain, caring for their spiritual needs.
sections.content_en: Fra Josip Vlašić describes life in the mountain environment of **Blidinje**, **Čvrsnica**, and **Vrana** as a privilege, emphasizing the beauty of the nature park. However, winters bring challenges such as impassable roads, which requires preparedness and supplies. Speaking about history, Fra Josip explains how the Franciscans arrived in Masna Luka. People from **Hercegovina** came with their herds for grazing in the mountain from May to September. The Franciscans, like a shepherd who does not abandon his flock, followed them, providing spiritual care. Professors from **Široki Brijeg** regularly came to celebrate Masses, baptize, marry, and bury. The tragedy of the Second World War, with the massacre in **Rama** and the burning of the Franciscan house in 1942, interrupted their permanent presence for forty years. Despite this, the Franciscans still came occasionally, serving Masses in cemeteries. The idea of returning and building a new house was born in the heart of **Fra Petar Krasić** in the late 70s and early 80s. Fra Petar dedicated 40 years of his life to building the complex in Masna Luka, whose dominant parts today are the church and the large Franciscan House of Prayer.

sections.subtitle: Franjevačka kuća molitve: Oaza duhovnosti na 1200 metara nadmorske visine
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip objašnjava svrhu Franjevačke kuće molitve u Masnoj Luci kao mjesta za bijeg od buke i gužve.
sections.content: Kao voditelj Franjevačke kuće molitve, Fra Josip Vlašić ističe jedinstvenost lokacije **Masne Luke** na 1200 metara nadmorske visine. Uspoređuje je s **La Vernom**, planinom svetog Franje Asiškog, koja je također bila mjesto povlačenja za molitvu i nalazi se na sličnoj nadmorskoj visini. Cilj Kuće molitve je da Masna Luka postane 'La Verna' za franjevce, ali i 'gora' za sve koji traže utočište od svakodnevne buke i gužve. Kroz razne seminare, duhovne vježbe i obnove, Kuća molitve nudi prostor za dublji susret s Bogom. Ponuda je raznolika, uključujući seminare šutnje, posta, pokreta, te programe prilagođene mladima, muškarcima, ženama i svećenicima. Većina programa (80%) organizira se interno, dok se 20% termina ustupa drugim zajednicama. Fra Josip naglašava da je fokus na odrasloj populaciji, budući da mladi, poput članova **Frame**, već imaju dobro strukturirane programe. Informacije o seminarima i prijavama dostupne su na web stranici www.massnaluka.ba.

magisterium.assessment: Usporedba s La Vernom je prikladna duhovna metafora koja naglašava važnost mjesta za molitvu i povlačenje u tišinu. Takva mjesta su u skladu s tradicijom 'pustinje' ili 'gore' kao mjesta susreta s Bogom.
magisterium.enrichment: Sveti Franjo Asiški je često tražio osamu na La Verni kako bi se sjedinio s Bogom u molitvi, što je uzor za svakog vjernika. Crkva potiče stvaranje prostora za duhovnu obnovu i tišinu kao nužnu protutežu užurbanosti suvremenog svijeta.
magisterium.assessment_en: The comparison with La Verna is an appropriate spiritual metaphor which emphasizes the importance of a place for prayer and retreat into silence. Such places are in accordance with the tradition of the 'desert' or 'mountain' as places of encounter with God.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Saint Francis of Assisi often sought solitude on La Verna in order to unite himself with God in prayer, which is a model for every believer. The Church encourages the creation of space for spiritual renewal and silence as a necessary counterweight to the busyness of the modern world.

sections.subtitle_en: Franciscan House of Prayer: Oasis of spirituality at 1200 meters above sea level
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip explains the purpose of the Franjevačka kuća molitve in Masna Luka as a place for escape from noise and crowds.
sections.content_en: As the leader of the Franjevačka kuća molitve, Fra Josip Vlašić highlights the uniqueness of the location of **Masna Luka** at 1200 meters above sea level. He compares it with **La Verna**, the mountain of Saint Francis of Assisi, which was also a place of retreat for prayer and is located at a similar altitude above sea level. The goal of the Kuća molitve is for Masna Luka to become 'La Verna' for Franciscans, but also a 'mountain' for all who seek refuge from everyday noise and crowds. Through various seminars, spiritual exercises, and renewals, the Kuća molitve offers a space for a deeper encounter with God. The offer is diverse, including seminars of silence, fasting, movement, and programs adapted to youth, men, women, and priests. Most of the programs (80%) are organized internally, while 20% of the slots are ceded to other communities. Fra Josip emphasizes that the focus is on the adult population, since the youth, like the members of **Frama**, already have well-structured programs. Information about seminars and registrations is available on the website www.massnaluka.ba.

sections.subtitle: Masna Luka kao 'Gora Preobraženja': Susret s Bogom u tišini planine
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip govori o Masnoj Luci kao mjestu gdje ljudi doživljavaju preobraženje, slično Isusovoj Gori Tabor.
sections.content: Planina u Svetom pismu ima posebno značenje kao mjesto Božje objave i susreta s čovjekom. Fra Josip Vlašić podsjeća na primjere poput **Mojsija** na **Sinaju** i **Isusa** koji se često povlačio na goru. Dolazak ljudi u Masnu Luku na duhovne vježbe Fra Josip vidi kao poticaj **Duha Svetoga**, uspoređujući ga s Isusovim pozivom **Petru**, **Ivanu** i **Jakovu** da ga slijede na visoku goru. Iz povratnih informacija sudionika, Masna Luka postaje za mnoge njihova 'gora preobraženja', mjesto samoće i molitve gdje doživljavaju duboku osobnu transformaciju. Kao što je **Gora Tabor** bila mjesto Isusovog preobraženja, tako i Masna Luka postaje prostor gdje se ljudi preobražavaju, što je i razlog njihovog ponovnog dolaska.

magisterium.assessment: Tumačenje planine kao mjesta Božje objave i preobraženja je duboko ukorijenjeno u Svetom pismu i kršćanskoj tradiciji. Povezivanje osobnog iskustva vjernika s biblijskim događajima na gori je ispravan način duhovne formacije.
magisterium.enrichment: Biblijski izvještaji o Sinaju i Taboru pokazuju da Bog poziva čovjeka na 'goru' kako bi ga preobrazio i objavio mu svoju volju. Ovo iskustvo susreta s Bogom u tišini ključno je za duhovni rast i produbljivanje vjere, omogućujući vjerniku da se vrati u svakodnevni život preobražen.
magisterium.assessment_en: The interpretation of the mountain as a place of God's revelation and transfiguration is deeply rooted in Holy Scripture and Christian tradition. Connecting the personal experience of the believer with biblical events on the mountain is the correct way of spiritual formation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Biblical accounts about Sinaj and Tabor show that God calls man to the 'mountain' in order to transform him and reveal to him His will. This experience of encounter with God in silence is crucial for spiritual growth and the deepening of faith, enabling the believer to return to everyday life transformed.

sections.subtitle_en: Masna Luka as the 'Mount of Transfiguration': An Encounter with God in the Silence of the Mountain
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip speaks about Masna Luka as a place where people experience transfiguration, similar to Jesus' Mount Tabor.
sections.content_en: The mountain in Holy Scripture has a special meaning as a place of God's revelation and encounter with man. Fra Josip Vlašić recalls examples like **Mojsije** on **Sinaj** and **Isus** who often withdrew to the mountain. Fra Josip sees the arrival of people in Masna Luka for spiritual retreats as an impulse of the **Holy Spirit**, comparing it to Jesus' invitation to **Petar**, **Ivan**, and **Jakov** to follow Him to a high mountain. From the feedback of the participants, Masna Luka becomes for many their 'mountain of transfiguration', a place of solitude and prayer where they experience a deep personal transformation. Just as **Gora Tabor** was the place of Jesus' transfiguration, so also Masna Luka becomes a space where people are transfigured, which is also the reason for their return.

sections.subtitle: Molitva kao odnos, slušanje i 'disanje duše'
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip objašnjava molitvu kao 'disanje duše', naglašavajući njezinu vitalnost za duhovni život.
sections.content: Voditelj postavlja pitanje o dubljem značenju molitve, izvan uobičajene definicije 'razgovora s Bogom'. Fra Josip Vlašić potvrđuje da je molitva prije svega **odnos**. Iako je razgovor s Bogom važan, često se pretvara u monolog, gdje čovjek samo govori, a ne sluša. Takva molitva, kaže Fra Josip, zapravo se i ne događa. Prava molitva je **odgovor na Božju riječ**, što znači da je prvenstveno **slušanje**. Koristi slikovitu usporedbu s gitarom: žica sama ne svira, potreban je dodir da bi se oslobodio zvuk. Slično, Božja riječ mora dotaknuti naše srce da bi ono odgovorilo molitvom. Fra Josip ističe da 'svaki susret s Bogom je molitva, ali nije svaka molitva susret s Bogom'. Podsjeća na Isusovo upozorenje da ne brbljamo kao pogani. Mnogi kršćani, unatoč godinama vjere, ostaju na površnoj razini molitve, doživljavajući je kao obvezu koju treba 'odmoliti'. Međutim, molitva je život u Bogu, **'disanje duše'**. Kao što tijelo umire bez disanja, tako i duhovni život prestaje bez molitve, bez tog osobnog odnosa s Bogom.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak u potpunosti odražava katoličko učenje o molitvi kao odnosu i dijalogu s Bogom.
magisterium.enrichment: Katekizam Katoličke Crkve (KKC 2558, 2567) definira molitvu kao vitalan i osoban odnos s Bogom, gdje je molitva odgovor na Božju inicijativu ljubavi. Molitva nije samo govor, već slušanje i 'uzdizanje srca' k Bogu, što zahtijeva prisutnost srca (KKC 2700).
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage fully reflects Catholic teaching on prayer as a relationship and dialogue with God.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catechism of the Catholic Church (CCC 2558, 2567) defines prayer as a vital and personal relationship with God, where prayer is a response to God's initiative of love. Prayer is not only speech, but listening and the 'raising of the heart' to God, which requires the presence of the heart (CCC 2700).

sections.subtitle_en: Prayer as relationship, listening and 'breathing of the soul'
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip explains prayer as 'breathing of the soul', emphasizing its vitality for spiritual life.
sections.content_en: The host poses a question about the deeper meaning of prayer, beyond the usual definition of 'conversation with God'. Fra Josip Vlašić confirms that prayer is first of all a **relationship**. Although conversation with God is important, it often turns into a monologue, where man only speaks and does not listen. Such prayer, says Fra Josip, actually does not even happen. True prayer is an **answer to God's word**, which means that it is primarily **listening**. He uses a vivid comparison with a guitar: a string does not play by itself, a touch is needed to release the sound. Similarly, God's word must touch our heart so that it would respond with prayer. Fra Josip emphasizes that 'every encounter with God is prayer, but not every prayer is an encounter with God'. He recalls Jesus' warning not to babble like pagans. Many Christians, despite years of faith, remain at a superficial level of prayer, experiencing it as an obligation that needs to be 'prayed through'. However, prayer is life in God, the **'breathing of the soul'**. Just as the body dies without breathing, so also spiritual life ceases without prayer, without that personal relationship with God.

sections.subtitle: Vjera, povjerenje i poniznost: Temelji istinske molitve
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip objašnjava poniznost kao ključni preduvjet za molitvu, naglašavajući svijest o potrebi za Bogom.
sections.content: Kada se govori o temeljima molitve, Fra Josip Vlašić ističe nekoliko ključnih elemenata: **vjeru, povjerenje, predanje i poniznost**. Posebno naglašava poniznost kao važan preduvjet. Ohol i samodostatan čovjek neće moliti jer ne osjeća potrebu za Bogom, što je, kako kaže, oblik idolopoklonstva. Poniznost, s druge strane, podrazumijeva svijest o vlastitoj nedovoljnosti i potrebi za Bogom. Fra Josip podsjeća na biblijski primjer apostola koji nisu uspjeli istjerati zlog duha, na što je Isus odgovorio da se takav duh istjeruje samo molitvom i postom. To je, objašnjava, svijest o vlastitoj nemoći i potrebi za Božjom pomoći u suočavanju sa životnim izazovima. Kroz molitvu, čovjek svjesno i voljno otvara prostor za Božje djelovanje u svom životu, prepoznajući da je Bog taj koji djeluje.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno identificira poniznost i vjeru kao temelje kršćanske molitve.
magisterium.enrichment: Poniznost je temelj molitve jer nas čini svjesnima da smo 'prosjaci pred Bogom' (KKC 2559). Oholost, koja se očituje u samodostatnosti, suprotna je duhu molitve, dok vjera i povjerenje omogućuju autentičan susret s Bogom (KKC 2728).
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly identifies humility and faith as the foundations of Christian prayer.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Humility is the foundation of prayer because it makes us aware that we are 'beggars before God' (CCC 2559). Pride, which manifests itself in self-sufficiency, is contrary to the spirit of prayer, while faith and trust enable an authentic encounter with God (CCC 2728).

sections.subtitle_en: Faith, trust and humility: Foundations of true prayer
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip explains humility as a key prerequisite for prayer, emphasizing the awareness of the need for God.
sections.content_en: When speaking about the foundations of prayer, Fra Josip Vlašić highlights several key elements: **faith, trust, surrender and humility**. He especially emphasizes humility as an important prerequisite. A proud and self-sufficient man will not pray because he does not feel the need for God, which is, as he says, a form of idolatry. Humility, on the other hand, implies awareness of one's own insufficiency and need for God. Fra Josip recalls the biblical example of the apostles who did not succeed in casting out an evil spirit, to which Jesus replied that such a spirit is cast out only by prayer and fasting. This is, he explains, an awareness of one's own helplessness and the need for God's help in facing life's challenges. Through prayer, man consciously and willingly opens space for God's action in his life, recognizing that God is the one who acts.

sections.subtitle: Od 'trgovačkog' odnosa do duboke ljubavi: Razvoj molitve
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip govori o Isusu kao primjeru molitve, koji se povlačio u samoću prije i poslije važnih događaja.
sections.content: Voditelj postavlja pitanje kako transformirati molitvu iz često 'trgovačkog' odnosa, gdje se od Boga nešto traži u zamjenu za molitvu. Fra Josip Vlašić objašnjava da molitva, poput vjere, raste i razvija se. Osoba koja istinski čezne za Bogom i ljubi Ga, s vremenom će shvatiti da takav 'pogodbeni' odnos ostavlja srce praznim. Srce će tada tražiti nešto dublje i autentičnije. Isus je, svojim životom i primjerom, pozivao na molitvu i razgovor s Ocem. Redovito se povlačio u samoću, molio prije važnih odluka i nakon čudesa, provodio noći u molitvi, a njegov četrdesetodnevni boravak u pustinji bio je intenzivan prostor molitve i razgovora s nebeskim Ocem. Fra Josip ističe da je Isus, iako pravi Bog, bio i pravi čovjek te mu je molitva bila neophodna. Njegov primjer pokazuje da molitva nije opcija, već vitalna potreba za svakog čovjeka.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno usmjerava vjernika od 'trgovačkog' odnosa prema dubljoj ljubavi i povjerenju.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćanska molitva treba težiti suobličavanju s voljom Očevom, a ne samo traženju darova (KKC 2740). Prelazak s 'trgovačkog' odnosa na odnos ljubavi odražava duhovni rast gdje se srce usklađuje s Božjom željom (KKC 2735).
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly directs the believer from a 'transactional' relationship towards deeper love and trust.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Christian prayer should strive for conformation to the Father's will, and not only to seeking gifts (CCC 2740). The transition from a 'mercantile' relationship to a relationship of love reflects spiritual growth where the heart aligns with God's desire (CCC 2735).

sections.subtitle_en: From a 'transactional' relationship to deep love: The development of prayer
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip speaks about Jesus as an example of prayer, who withdrew into solitude before and after important events.
sections.content_en: The host poses the question of how to transform prayer from an often 'transactional' relationship, where something is asked of God in exchange for prayer. Fra Josip Vlašić explains that prayer, like faith, grows and develops. A person who truly yearns for God and loves Him will, over time, realize that such a 'bargaining' relationship leaves the heart empty. The heart will then seek something deeper and more authentic. Jesus, by his life and example, called for prayer and conversation with the Father. He regularly withdrew into solitude, prayed before important decisions and after miracles, spent nights in prayer, and his forty-day stay in the desert was an intense space of prayer and conversation with the heavenly Father. Fra Josip points out that Jesus, although true God, was also true man and prayer was necessary for him. His example shows that prayer is not an option, but a vital need for every person.

sections.subtitle: Osobna i zajednička molitva: Srce duhovnog života i izazovi javnog izričaja
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip izražava žaljenje zbog kršćana koji nisu iskusili ljepotu osobnog odnosa s Bogom kroz molitvu.
sections.content: Isusov primjer pokazuje važnost i osobne i zajedničke molitve. Molio je sam, s malim krugom učenika (Petar, Ivan, Jakov na Taboru i u Getsemanskom vrtu) te s narodom u sinagogama. Fra Josip Vlašić naglašava da je **osobna molitva srce duhovnog života**. Bez nje, kršćanski život postaje sterilan i površan. Kao svećenik, ističe da bi njegovo djelovanje bez osobnog odnosa s Isusom postalo samo 'bildanje ega'. Žali zbog kršćana koji nisu iskusili snagu i ljepotu osobnog odnosa s Bogom, jer njihov život ostaje površan. Govoreći o javnoj molitvi, poput krunice na trgovima, Fra Josip podsjeća na Isusovu prispodobu o farizeju i cariniku. Nije važno gdje se moli, već **raspoloženje srca**. Molitva ne smije biti parada ili dokazivanje, već uzdizanje srca Gospodinu iz čiste ljubavi. U centru molitve treba biti Bog, a čovjek obgrljen Bogom. Molitva je prostor 'bivanja u Bogu', kako je rekao sveti Pavao, pomažući nam da svjesno živimo u Njegovoj prisutnosti.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno naglašava važnost osobne i zajedničke molitve te njihovu međusobnu povezanost.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče i osobnu i zajedničku molitvu, pri čemu je osobna molitva srce duhovnog života (KKC 2691). Osobna molitva i liturgijska molitva Crkve nisu u opreci, već se međusobno nadopunjuju i hrane (KKC 2696, 2700).
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly emphasizes the importance of personal and communal prayer and their mutual connectedness.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages both personal and communal prayer, whereby personal prayer is the heart of spiritual life (CCC 2691). Personal prayer and the liturgical prayer of the Church are not in opposition, but complement and nourish each other (CCC 2696, 2700).

sections.subtitle_en: Personal and communal prayer: The heart of spiritual life and challenges of public expression
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip expresses regret for Christians who have not experienced the beauty of a personal relationship with God through prayer.
sections.content_en: Jesus' example shows the importance of both personal and communal prayer. He prayed alone, with a small circle of disciples (Petar, Ivan, Jakov on Tabor and in the Getsemanski vrt) and with the people in synagogues. Fra Josip Vlašić emphasizes that **personal prayer is the heart of spiritual life**. Without it, Christian life becomes sterile and superficial. As a priest, he points out that his activity without a personal relationship with Jesus would become only 'ego building'. He laments the Christians who have not experienced the power and beauty of a personal relationship with God, because their life remains superficial. Speaking of public prayer, like the Rosary in public squares, Fra Josip reminds of Jesus' parable of the Pharisee and the tax collector. It is not important where one prays, but **the disposition of the heart**. Prayer must not be a parade or proving oneself, but the lifting up of the heart to the Lord out of pure love. In the center of prayer should be God, and man embraced by God. Prayer is a space of 'being in God', as Saint Paul said, helping us to consciously live in His presence.

sections.subtitle: Slušanje Božjeg glasa: Ruminatio i tišina kao preduvjet molitve
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip objašnjava pojam 'ruminatio' kao proces 'preživanja' Božje riječi kako bi se iz nje izvukla sva slast.
sections.content: U kontekstu molitve, Fra Josip Vlašić ističe važnost **slušanja Boga**. Bog progovara srcu čovjeka, a najsigurniji put za čuti Ga je kroz **Sveto pismo**. Objašnjava praksu **'ruminatio'** (preživanja), koju su prakticirali **Pustinjski oci**. Poput krava koje preživaju travu da bi izvukle svu slast, tako i vjernik treba slušati Božju riječ, pronaći tišinu, a zatim je 'preživati' – razmišljati o njoj, povezivati je sa svojim životom i dopustiti joj da odjekuje u sebi. Kroz taj proces oslobađaju se 'Božji sokovi' i milost koja prožima život. Fra Josip naglašava da je u današnjem vremenu, ispunjenom bukom, obvezama i ekranima, najveća napast za dobru molitvu **nedostatak vremena i tišine**. Stvaranje prostora šutnje ključan je preduvjet za molitvu i osigurava da duhovni život ne skrene s pravog puta ili se ne izgubi.

magisterium.assessment: Fra Josip ispravno naglašava važnost slušanja Božje riječi i tradicijsku praksu 'ruminatio' (preživanja) kao ključnu za molitveni život.
magisterium.enrichment: Katekizam (KKC 2699) potvrđuje da je Sveto pismo vrelo molitve, a 'ruminatio' (lectio divina) drevna je praksa Crkve koja pomaže da Božja riječ postane dio srca vjernika.
magisterium.assessment_en: Fra Josip correctly emphasizes the importance of listening to God's word and the traditional practice of 'ruminatio' (rumination) as key to prayer life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catechism (CCC 2699) confirms that Sacred Scripture is the source of prayer, and 'ruminatio' (lectio divina) is an ancient practice of the Church that helps the Word of God become part of the heart of the believer.

sections.subtitle_en: Listening to God's voice: Ruminatio and silence as a prerequisite for prayer
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip explains the term 'ruminatio' as a process of 'chewing the cud' of the Word of God in order to extract all sweetness from it.
sections.content_en: In the context of prayer, Fra Josip Vlašić emphasizes the importance of **listening to God**. God speaks to the heart of man, and the safest way to hear Him is through **Holy Scripture**. He explains the practice of **'ruminatio'** (rumination), which was practiced by the **Desert Fathers**. Like cows that ruminate grass to extract all the sweetness, so also the believer should listen to the Word of God, find silence, and then 'ruminate' it – reflect on it, connect it with their life, and allow it to echo within themselves. Through this process, 'God's juices' and grace that permeates life are released. Fra Josip emphasizes that in today's time, filled with noise, obligations, and screens, the greatest temptation for good prayer is the **lack of time and silence**. Creating a space of silence is a key prerequisite for prayer and ensures that the spiritual life does not stray from the right path or get lost.

sections.subtitle: Prvine dana za Boga: Primjer Majke Terezije i Ivana Kasijana
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip objašnjava analogiju Svetog Ivana Kasijana o mlinu, naglašavajući važnost posvećivanja prvih trenutaka dana Bogu.
sections.content: Fra Josip Vlašić naglašava da se za molitvu ne moli 'kada imamo vremena', već 'kada odlučimo izdvojiti vrijeme'. Podsjeća na izreku **Majke Terezije**: 'Ako imaš puno posla, moli dva sata; ako imaš još više, moli tri sata', ističući njezinu praksu svakodnevne dvosatne molitve pred Presvetim. Vrijeme je uvijek isto, 24 sata, a pitanje je samo što nam je važno. Ako nam je Bog važan, pronaći ćemo vrijeme za molitvu. Fra Josip ističe da **prvine dana pripadaju Bogu**, a jutra su posebno dragocjena za molitvu. Poziva se na misao **Svetog Ivana Kasijana** i njegovu analogiju s mlinom: prvo žito koje mlinar stavi u mlin melje se cijeli dan. Slično, ono čime započnemo dan često ga obilježi. Stoga je važno 'pohraniti dobro sjeme' – Božju riječ – u sebe ujutro. Jutarnja molitva, bilo šutnje, klanjanja ili razmatranja, otvara život Bogu i Njegovoj prisutnosti, obilježavajući cijeli dan. Upozorava na pogrešku molitve samo na kraju dana, kada smo umorni, iako je zaspati u molitvi lijepo. Predlaže čitanje sutrašnjeg Evanđelja navečer i ponovno ujutro, kao način pohranjivanja Božje riječi u sebe.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na svjesnom izdvajanju vremena za molitvu, umjesto čekanja 'slobodnog vremena', u potpunosti je u skladu s katoličkom duhovnom tradicijom.
magisterium.enrichment: KKC 2651 i 2699 naglašavaju važnost ustrajnosti i 'odlučne volje' u molitvi, neovisno o osjećajima ili vanjskim okolnostima, što potvrđuje i primjer svetaca poput Terezije Avilske.
magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on consciously setting aside time for prayer, instead of waiting for 'free time', is fully in accordance with Catholic spiritual tradition.
magisterium.enrichment_en: CCC 2651 and 2699 emphasize the importance of perseverance and 'determined will' in prayer, independently of feelings or external circumstances, which is also confirmed by the example of saints like Terezija Avilska.

sections.subtitle_en: First fruits of the day for God: The example of Mother Teresa and Ivan Kasijan
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip explains Saint John Cassian's analogy of the mill, emphasizing the importance of dedicating the first moments of the day to God.
sections.content_en: Fra Josip Vlašić emphasizes that one does not pray 'when we have time', but 'when we decide to set aside time'. He recalls the saying of **Mother Teresa**: 'If you have a lot of work, pray for two hours; if you have even more, pray for three hours', emphasizing her practice of daily two-hour prayer before the Blessed Sacrament. Time is always the same, 24 hours, and the only question is what is important to us. If God is important to us, we will find time for prayer. Fra Josip points out that **the firstfruits of the day belong to God**, and mornings are especially precious for prayer. He refers to the thought of **Saint John Cassian** and his analogy with the mill: the first grain that the miller puts into the mill is ground all day. Similarly, that with which we begin the day often marks it. Therefore it is important to 'store the good seed' – God's word – within oneself in the morning. Morning prayer, whether of silence, adoration, or meditation, opens life to God and His presence, marking the entire day. He warns of the mistake of praying only at the end of the day, when we are tired, although falling asleep in prayer is beautiful. He suggests reading tomorrow's Gospel in the evening and again in the morning, as a way of storing God's word within oneself.

sections.subtitle: Raznolikost molitvenih izričaja: Od šutnje do zagovora
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip govori o molitvi šutnje i predanja kao najljepšoj, gdje se čovjek sjedinjuje s Isusom.
sections.content:
Fra Josip Vlašić dijeli svoje osobno iskustvo, ističući **molitvu šutnje i predanja** kao najljepšu. To je molitva s malo riječi, ali s puno predanja, poput Isusovih riječi na Kalvariji: 'Oče, u ruke tvoje predajem duh svoj.' Zatim prelazi na različite vrste molitve koje spominje i Katekizam Katoličke Crkve:  
- **Molitva prošnje:** Najčešća, gdje od Boga tražimo svoje potrebe, ohrabreni Isusovim riječima 'kucajte, tražite, ištite'. Ipak, to je možda najskromniji oblik molitve.  
- **Molitva zahvaljivanja:** Smatra je najljepšom preporukom Bogu i ljudima. Ne zahvaljuje se samo za ono što nam je Bog dao, već za Njega samoga – za dar spasenja, Duha Svetoga, Njegove riječi i Crkve.  
- **Molitva klanjanja:** Sve je češća, posebno kroz kapelice trajnog euharistijskog klanjanja, čiji je poticaj, vjeruje Fra Josip, došao iz **Međugorja**. Euharistija je 'ljubav srca Isusova', kako je rekao **Benedikt XVI.**, i predstavlja predivan prostor za molitvu u prisutnosti Presvetog Sakramenta.  
- **Zagovorna molitva:** Stajanje pred Bogom za druge. Fra Josip ističe važnost molitve drugih za evangelizacijske projekte, poput e-duhovnih vježbi, gdje se traži molitva kontemplativnih sestara. Primjer **Marije** u **Kani** i četvorice koji su donijeli uzetoga pred Isusa ilustriraju snagu zagovora. Potrebna je poniznost da se zatraži molitva drugih. Fra Josip se prisjeća propovijedi **Fra Zvjezdana Linića** o zagovornoj molitvi, gdje je fra Zvjezdan bio spreman preuzeti bolest drugoga, pokazujući istinsku ljubav i predanje.  
  
Govoreći o izričajima molitve:  
- **Usmena molitva:** Prvi oblik koji učimo, važan za izražavanje, ali ne smije ostati jedini.  
- **Misaona molitva (razmatranje):** Aktivniji angažman uma, često uz Božju riječ, ali može biti i razmatranje Božjih tajni ili vlastite smrtnosti (Sveti Petar Alkantarski, Sveti Ignacije Lojolski). **Thomas Merton** je opisuje kao 'vježbanje uma ozbiljnim razmatranjima'.  
- **Kontemplativna molitva:** 'Motrenje', čisti Božji dar, područje mistike. Usmena i misaona molitva pripremaju nas za nju. To je 'počivanje u Bogu', iskustvo Njegove prisutnosti, gdje um postaje pasivan, a srce doživljava jedinstvo s Bogom. **Sveti Augustin** je rekao: 'Kad sam se vratio k sebi, ja sam tebe, Bože, našao u sebi.' To je odsutnost riječi i mir uma, spuštanje u srce da se susretne Boga koji prebiva u nama.

magisterium.assessment: Fra Josip ispravno navodi raznolikost molitvenih izričaja i njihovu utemeljenost u Katekizmu, naglašavajući važnost predanja.
magisterium.enrichment: KKC 2699 jasno definira tri glavna izraza molitve: usmenu, razmatranje i kontemplaciju, dok je predanje (poput Isusova na križu) vrhunac molitvenog sjedinjenja s Ocem.
magisterium.assessment_en: Fra Josip correctly states the diversity of prayer expressions and their foundation in the Catechism, emphasizing the importance of surrender.
magisterium.enrichment_en: CCC 2699 clearly defines three main expressions of prayer: vocal, meditation, and contemplation, while surrender (like Jesus' on the cross) is the summit of prayerful union with the Father.

sections.subtitle_en: Diversity of prayer expressions: From silence to intercession
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip speaks about the prayer of silence and surrender as the most beautiful one, where a person unites with Jesus.
sections.content_en:
Fra Josip Vlašić shares his personal experience, highlighting the **prayer of silence and surrender** as the most beautiful. This is a prayer with few words, but with much surrender, like Jesus' words on Calvary: 'Father, into your hands I commend my spirit.' Then he moves on to the different types of prayer that the Catechism of the Catholic Church also mentions:
- **Prayer of petition:** The most common, where we ask God for our needs, encouraged by Jesus' words 'knock, seek, ask'. Still, it is perhaps the most modest form of prayer.
- **Prayer of thanksgiving:** He considers it the most beautiful recommendation to God and people. One does not thank only for what God has given us, but for Him Himself – for the gift of salvation, the Holy Spirit, His word and the Church.
- **Prayer of adoration:** It is increasingly common, especially through chapels of perpetual Eucharistic adoration, whose impulse, Fra Josip believes, came from **Međugorje**. The Eucharist is 'the love of the heart of Jesus', as **Benedikt XVI.** said, and represents a beautiful space for prayer in the presence of the Blessed Sacrament.
- **Intercessory prayer:** Standing before God for others. Fra Josip highlights the importance of the prayer of others for evangelization projects, like e-spiritual exercises, where the prayer of contemplative sisters is requested. The example of **Marija** in **Kana** and the four who brought the paralytic before Jesus illustrate the power of intercession. Humility is needed to request the prayer of others. Fra Josip recalls the sermon of **Fra Zvjezdan Linić** about intercessory prayer, where fra Zvjezdan was ready to take on the illness of another, showing true love and surrender.

Speaking of the expressions of prayer:
- **Vocal prayer:** The first form we learn, important for expression, but it must not remain the only one.
- **Mental prayer (meditation):** More active engagement of the mind, often with the Word of God, but it can also be the meditation on God's mysteries or one's own mortality (Sveti Petar Alkantarski, Sveti Ignacije Lojolski). **Thomas Merton** describes it as 'exercising the mind with serious considerations'.
- **Contemplative prayer:** 'Contemplation', a pure gift of God, the realm of mysticism. Vocal and mental prayer prepare us for it. It is 'resting in God', the experience of His presence, where the mind becomes passive, and the heart experiences union with God. **Sveti Augustin** said: 'When I returned to myself, I found you, God, in myself.' It is the absence of words and peace of mind, descending into the heart to meet God who dwells in us.

sections.subtitle: Molitva razmatranja i kontemplacija: Put prema dubljem iskustvu Boga
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip Vlašić objašnjava razliku između molitve razmatranja i kontemplativne molitve.
sections.content:
Fra Josip Vlašić detaljno objašnjava različite oblike molitve, počevši od molitve razmatranja. Citirajući **Thomasa Mertona**, ističe da razmatranje znači 'vježbati um ozbiljnim razmatranjima', što podrazumijeva aktivan misaoni napor. Spominje i svetog Ignacija Lojolskog, koji je poticao na razmatranje vlastite smrtnosti, što pokazuje da predmet razmatranja ne mora nužno biti samo Božja riječ, već i duboke životne istine ili Božje tajne.

Nakon razmatranja, Fra Josip prelazi na kontemplativnu molitvu, opisujući je kao najviši oblik molitve i čisti **Božji dar**. Dok su usmena molitva i razmatranje podložni ljudskoj volji i aktivnosti, kontemplacija je motrenje, stanje u kojem se čovjek potpuno predaje Bogu. To je područje mistike, gdje um postaje pasivan, a srce doživljava prisutnost Božju. Kontemplacija je 'počivanje u Bogu', iskustvo jedinstva s Njim, gdje čovjek osjeća Božji zagrljaj. Sveti Augustin je to lijepo opisao rekavši da je Boga tražio izvan sebe, a pronašao ga u sebi, jer mu je Bog bio bliži nego on sam sebi. Sve što čovjek može učiniti jest pripraviti se za primanje te milosti kontemplacije kroz druge oblike molitve.

magisterium.assessment: Razlikovanje između razmatranja (aktivni napor uma) i kontemplacije (Božji dar) teološki je precizno i usklađeno s crkvenim naukom.
magisterium.enrichment: KKC 2705-2719 detaljno objašnjava razliku: razmatranje angažira misli i maštu, dok je kontemplacija 'pogled vjere' i dar milosti koji vodi u dublje sjedinjenje s Bogom.
magisterium.assessment_en: The distinction between meditation (active effort of the mind) and contemplation (God's gift) is theologically precise and aligned with Church teaching.
magisterium.enrichment_en: CCC 2705-2719 explains the difference in detail: meditation engages thoughts and imagination, while contemplation is a 'gaze of faith' and a gift of grace that leads into a deeper union with God.

sections.subtitle_en: Prayer of meditation and contemplation: Path towards a deeper experience of God
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip Vlašić explains the difference between the prayer of meditation and contemplative prayer.
sections.content_en:
Fra Josip Vlašić explains in detail the different forms of prayer, starting with the prayer of meditation. Quoting **Thomas Merton**, he points out that meditation means 'to exercise the mind with serious considerations', which implies an active mental effort. He also mentions Saint Ignatius of Loyola, who encouraged meditation on one's own mortality, which shows that the subject of meditation does not necessarily have to be only the Word of God, but also deep life truths or God's mysteries.

After meditation, Fra Josip moves on to contemplative prayer, describing it as the highest form of prayer and a pure **gift of God**. While vocal prayer and meditation are subject to human will and activity, contemplation is gazing, a state in which a person completely surrenders to God. This is the realm of mysticism, where the mind becomes passive and the heart experiences the presence of God. Contemplation is 'resting in God', an experience of unity with Him, where a person feels God's embrace. Saint Augustine beautifully described this by saying that he sought God outside of himself, and found Him within himself, because God was closer to him than he was to himself. All that a person can do is prepare themselves to receive that grace of contemplation through other forms of prayer.

sections.subtitle: Lectio Divina: Povezivanje Božje riječi sa životom kroz 'preživanje'
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip objašnjava metodu Lectio Divine i važnost povezivanja Božje riječi s osobnim životom.
sections.content:
U kontekstu razmatranja, Fra Josip Vlašić naglašava važnost **Lectio Divine** (božanskog čitanja), metode koja je najsigurnije vezana uz Sveto pismo. Ilustrira to pričom o dječaku koji je 'ukrao' priču jer je osjetio da je to priča o njegovom životu, naglašavajući kako Božja riječ treba postati osobna priča svakog vjernika.

Objašnjava koncept *ruminatio*, koji su koristili pustinjski oci, uspoređujući ga s preživanjem hrane kod krava. To znači dugo i temeljito 'žvakanje' Božje riječi kako bi se iz nje iscrpila sva slast i životni sok. Kroz šutnju i osluškivanje, Božja riječ dotiče čovjeka, budi srce i pokreće molitvu. Fra Josip ističe da je najveća napast za molitvu u današnje vrijeme nedostatak vremena i buka, zbog čega je ključno stvoriti prostor šutnje.

Predstavlja i strukturu Lectio Divine u četiri koraka, uz dodatak pripreme i akcije:
- **Preparacija (Priprema):** Zaustaviti se, smiriti se i pripraviti srce za molitvu.
- **Lectio (Čitanje):** Čitanje Božje riječi i traženje onoga što se srcu veže, što je Božji govor meni.
- **Meditatio (Razmatranje):** Aktivna usmjerenost misli na pročitanu riječ, povezivanje s konkretnim detaljima vlastitog života. Fra Josip koristi usporedbu svetog Ivana Kasijana o mislima kao vjetru – ne možemo ih zaustaviti, ali se možemo zaštititi Božjom riječju.
- **Oratio (Molitva):** Izražavanje vlastitih potreba i želja Bogu, potaknuto razmatranjem. Slobodno se moli za ono što je u srcu.
- **Contemplatio (Kontemplacija):** Ostajanje u miru i prisutnosti Božjoj, prepuštanje Njegovoj prisutnosti.
- **Actio (Akcija):** Življenje onoga što je primljeno i nadahnuto u molitvi, prenošenje molitvenog iskustva u svakodnevni život, slično kao što se na kraju mise doživljava poslanje.

magisterium.assessment: Lectio Divina je duboko ukorijenjena u katoličkoj tradiciji kao metoda molitvenog čitanja Svetog pisma koja vodi od slušanja do kontemplacije. Naglasak na 'preživanju' (ruminatio) i povezivanju Riječi sa životom vjernika u potpunosti je u skladu s crkvenim naukom i praksom.
magisterium.enrichment: Lectio Divina pomaže vjerniku da premosti jaz između biblijskog teksta i svakodnevnog života, pretvarajući čitanje u dijalog s Bogom. Ova praksa, koju Crkva snažno potiče, omogućuje vjernicima da steknu 'nadnaravnu intuiciju' za razlučivanje Božje volje.
magisterium.assessment_en: Lectio Divina is deeply rooted in the Catholic tradition as a method of prayerful reading of Holy Scripture which leads from listening to contemplation. The emphasis on 'ruminating' (ruminatio) and connecting the Word with the life of the believer is fully in accordance with Church teaching and practice.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Lectio Divina helps the believer to bridge the gap between the biblical text and everyday life, turning reading into a dialogue with God. This practice, which the Church strongly encourages, enables believers to acquire a 'supernatural intuition' for discerning God's will.

sections.subtitle_en: Lectio Divina: Connecting the Word of God with life through 'rumination'
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip explains the method of Lectio Divina and the importance of connecting the Word of God with personal life.
sections.content_en:
In the context of meditation, Fra Josip Vlašić emphasizes the importance of **Lectio Divina** (divine reading), a method that is most securely tied to Holy Scripture. He illustrates this with a story about a boy who 'stole' a story because he felt that it was the story of his life, emphasizing how the Word of God needs to become the personal story of every believer.

He explains the concept of *ruminatio*, which the desert fathers used, comparing it to the rumination of food in cows. This means a long and thorough 'chewing' of the Word of God in order to extract all sweetness and life juice from it. Through silence and listening, the Word of God touches man, awakens the heart, and moves prayer. Fra Josip points out that the greatest temptation for prayer in today's time is the lack of time and noise, which is why it is crucial to create a space of silence.

He also presents the structure of Lectio Divina in four steps, with the addition of preparation and action:
- **Preparation (Preparation):** To stop, to calm down, and to prepare the heart for prayer.
- **Lectio (Reading):** Reading of the Word of God and searching for that which binds to the heart, which is God's speech to me.
- **Meditatio (Meditation):** Active focus of thoughts on the read word, connecting with concrete details of one's own life. Fra Josip uses the comparison of Saint John Cassian about thoughts as wind – we cannot stop them, but we can protect ourselves with the Word of God.
- **Oratio (Prayer):** Expressing one's own needs and desires to God, prompted by meditation. Pray freely for what is in the heart.
- **Contemplatio (Contemplation):** Remaining in the peace and presence of God, surrendering to His presence.
- **Actio (Action):** Living what was received and inspired in prayer, transferring the prayer experience into everyday life, similar to how the mission is experienced at the end of Mass.

sections.subtitle: Sveta Misa i Časoslov: Liturgijske molitve Crkve
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip Vlašić govori o važnosti Svete Mise i molitve Časoslova.
sections.content:
Fra Josip Vlašić naglašava da je **Sveta Misa** najveća molitva, izvan svih kategorija. To je molitva koju sam Isus Krist vrši u Crkvi i svijetu, i nema snažnije, bolje ili važnije molitve od nje. Upozorava na pogrešno shvaćanje da se čovjek može 'sam pomoliti kod kuće' umjesto sudjelovanja u Misi, ističući da je Isus s razlogom ostavio Svetu Misu kao trajni čin.

Govoreći o drugim liturgijskim molitvama, Fra Josip objašnjava **molitvu Časoslova** (Liturgiju časova) kao službenu molitvu Crkve. Ističe da je Isus molio psalme, što je bila židovska tradicija posvećivanja određenih dijelova dana Bogu. Časoslov je koncipiran oko jutarnje i večernje molitve, s dodatnim dnevnim molitvama i službom čitanja. Središte Časoslova su psalmi, njih 150, raspoređeni u četverotjedni ciklus. Redovnici, redovnice, svećenici, biskupi i mnogi laici prihvaćaju molitvu Časoslova kao svoju obvezu, postajući tako dio globalne molitve Crkve. Iako se može činiti monotonim zbog ponavljanja, Fra Josip naglašava da je to provjeren put molitve, star tisućljećima. Spominje i moderne aplikacije poput 'Nova Eva' i 'e-časoslov' (Kršćanske sadašnjosti) koje olakšavaju molitvu Časoslova.

magisterium.assessment: Ispravno se naglašava primat Svete Mise kao 'izvora i vrhunca' kršćanskog života, koja je po svojoj naravi javno bogoslužje Crkve, a ne privatna pobožnost. Upozorenje na važnost sudjelovanja u Misi naspram zamjene istom privatnom molitvom kod kuće teološki je precizno.
magisterium.enrichment: Liturgija, osobito Euharistija, je čin Krista i njegove Crkve, te stoga nadilazi svaku drugu molitvenu aktivnost po svojoj učinkovitosti. Časoslov je također službena molitva Crkve kojom se posvećuje vrijeme i pridružuje Kristovoj molitvi.
magisterium.assessment_en: The primacy of the Holy Mass is correctly emphasized as the 'source and summit' of Christian life, which is by its nature the public worship of the Church, and not a private devotion. The warning about the importance of participating in the Mass versus replacing it with private prayer at home is theologically precise.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Liturgy, especially the Eucharist, is the act of Christ and his Church, and therefore surpasses every other prayer activity by its efficacy. The Liturgy of the Hours is also the official prayer of the Church by which time is sanctified and joined to Christ's prayer.

sections.subtitle_en: Holy Mass and the Liturgy of the Hours: Liturgical Prayers of the Church
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip Vlašić speaks about the importance of the Holy Mass and the prayer of the Liturgy of the Hours.
sections.content_en:
Fra Josip Vlašić emphasizes that **Holy Mass** is the greatest prayer, beyond all categories. It is the prayer which Jesus Christ Himself performs in the Church and the world, and there is no stronger, better, or more important prayer than it. He warns against the misconception that a person can 'pray by himself at home' instead of participating in the Mass, emphasizing that Jesus left the Holy Mass as a permanent act for a reason.

Speaking of other liturgical prayers, Fra Josip explains the **prayer of the Breviary** (Liturgy of the Hours) as the official prayer of the Church. He points out that Jesus prayed the psalms, which was a Jewish tradition of consecrating certain parts of the day to God. The Breviary is designed around morning and evening prayer, with additional daily prayers and the Office of Readings. The center of the Breviary are the psalms, 150 of them, arranged in a four-week cycle. Religious brothers, religious sisters, priests, bishops, and many lay people accept the prayer of the Breviary as their obligation, thus becoming part of the global prayer of the Church. Although it may seem monotonous due to repetition, Fra Josip emphasizes that it is a proven path of prayer, millennia old. He also mentions modern applications like 'Nova Eva' and 'e-časoslov' (Kršćanske sadašnjosti) which facilitate the prayer of the Breviary.

sections.subtitle: Od ideje do aplikacije: Priča o 'e-duhovnim vježbama'
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip Vlašić priča o nastanku i razvoju aplikacije 'e-duhovne vježbe'.
sections.content:
Ideja za aplikaciju 'e-duhovne vježbe' rodila se u Mostaru, dok je Fra Josip Vlašić bio duhovni asistent Franjevačkog svjetovnog reda. Prvotna zamisao bila je aplikacija 'Oremus' za molitvene nakane, s mogućnošću vođenih duhovnih vježbi. Iako ta prva verzija nije zaživjela, ideja je putovala s Fra Josipom u Pazin, gdje je bio dio 'Mreže Sv. Josipova', neformalnog pokreta unutar franjevačkog reda koji traži nove načine življenja karizme i evangelizacije.

Godine 2017., nakon Božića 2016., Fra Josip je braći u Pazinu izložio ideju o pripremi tekstova za razmatranje i njihovoj distribuciji putem Facebooka ili e-maila. Fra Darko Tepert, tada profesor na Katoličkom bogoslovnom fakultetu, podržao je ideju. Ključnu ulogu u realizaciji imao je **Vlado Rosančić**, član Franjevačkog svjetovnog reda iz Zagreba, koji je upozorio na logističke izazove slanja e-mailova velikom broju ljudi i predložio korištenje servisa za masovnu distribuciju. Fra Josip ističe da je Vlado bio 'Božji dar' za projekt. Prve e-duhovne vježbe za Korizmu 2017. godine privukle su iznenađujuće velik broj sudionika – umjesto očekivanih stotinjak, prijavilo se preko 12.000 ljudi, što je potvrdilo potrebu za ovakvim oblikom digitalne evangelizacije.

magisterium.assessment: Opis razvoja aplikacije za duhovne vježbe pokazuje inicijativu za evangelizaciju i pomoć vjernicima u molitvenom životu. Korištenje tehnologije za promicanje duhovnosti unutar crkvenih okvira (OFS, franjevačka mreža) usklađeno je s poslanjem Crkve.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče korištenje suvremenih sredstava komunikacije za širenje Evanđelja, pod uvjetom da se zadrži autentičnost duhovne poruke. Duhovne vježbe, kao provjerena metoda, mogu biti učinkovito prilagođene suvremenim formatima za pomoć vjernicima u njihovom duhovnom rastu.
magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the development of the application for spiritual exercises shows an initiative for evangelization and assistance to believers in their prayer life. The use of technology for promoting spirituality within church frameworks (OFS, Franciscan network) is aligned with the mission of the Church.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages the use of modern means of communication for the spreading of the Gospel, under the condition that the authenticity of the spiritual message is preserved. Spiritual exercises, as a proven method, can be effectively adapted to modern formats to help believers in their spiritual growth.

sections.subtitle_en: From idea to application: The story of 'e-spiritual exercises'
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip Vlašić talks about the origin and development of the application 'e-duhovne vježbe'.
sections.content_en:
The idea for the 'e-duhovne vježbe' application was born in Mostar, while Fra Josip Vlašić was the spiritual assistant of the Franjevački svjetovni red. The original idea was the 'Oremus' application for prayer intentions, with the possibility of guided spiritual exercises. Although that first version did not come to life, the idea traveled with Fra Josip to Pazin, where he was part of 'Mreža Sv. Josipova', an informal movement within the Franciscan order that seeks new ways of living the charism and evangelization.

In the year 2017, after Christmas 2016, Fra Josip presented the idea to the brothers in Pazin about preparing texts for reflection and their distribution via Facebook or e-mail. Fra Darko Tepert, then a professor at the Katolički bogoslovni fakultet, supported the idea. A key role in the realization was held by **Vlado Rosančić**, a member of the Franjevački svjetovni red from Zagreb, who warned about the logistical challenges of sending e-mails to a large number of people and proposed the use of a service for mass distribution. Fra Josip points out that Vlado was 'God's gift' for the project. The first e-duhovne vježbe for Lent 2017 attracted a surprisingly large number of participants – instead of the expected hundred or so, over 12,000 people signed up, which confirmed the need for this form of digital evangelization.

sections.subtitle: Internet kao 'novi kontinent' za evangelizaciju
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip Vlašić govori o internetu kao 'novom kontinentu' za evangelizaciju.
sections.content:
Fra Josip Vlašić snažno podržava digitalnu evangelizaciju, dijeleći anegdotu s bratske duhovne obnove. Jedan fratar je internet opisao kao 'novi kontinent' na koji će se doseliti ljudi. Njegova poruka je bila jasna: ako Crkva ne dođe na taj kontinent s navještajem Evanđelja, netko drugi će navijestiti svoje 'evanđelje', koje možda neće biti Isusovo. Ova spoznaja bila je ključna potvrda za ideju 'e-duhovnih vježbi'.

Fra Josip naglašava da, iako internet može biti izvor napasti, ljudi su tamo, na društvenim mrežama. Stoga je prisutnost Crkve u tom digitalnom prostoru neophodna, uz oprez da se ne izgubi autentičnost. Cilj je navijestiti Isusa kao Spasitelja i radosnu vijest spasenja, koristeći moderne metode za dopiranje do što većeg broja ljudi.

magisterium.assessment: Koncept interneta kao 'novog kontinenta' za evangelizaciju u potpunosti je u skladu s pozivom Crkve na novu evangelizaciju u digitalnom prostoru. Nužnost prisutnosti Crkve na internetu kako bi se spriječilo širenje suprotstavljenih ideologija je ključna pastoralna strategija.
magisterium.enrichment: Digitalni prostor je postao privilegirano mjesto gdje se oblikuju nove kulture i paradigme, što zahtijeva od Crkve kreativnost i hrabrost u naviještanju Evanđelja. Bez kršćanske prisutnosti, taj prostor lako postaje podložan utjecajima koji su u suprotnosti s evanđeoskim vrijednostima.
magisterium.assessment_en: The concept of the internet as a 'new continent' for evangelization is fully in accordance with the call of the Church to a new evangelization in the digital space. The necessity of the presence of the Church on the internet in order to prevent the spread of opposing ideologies is a key pastoral strategy.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The digital space has become a privileged place where new cultures and paradigms are shaped, which requires from the Church creativity and courage in proclaiming the Gospel. Without Christian presence, that space easily becomes susceptible to influences that are in contradiction with Gospel values.

sections.subtitle_en: Internet as a 'new continent' for evangelization
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip Vlašić speaks about the internet as a 'new continent' for evangelization.
sections.content_en:
Fra Josip Vlašić strongly supports digital evangelization, sharing an anecdote from a fraternal spiritual renewal. One friar described the internet as a 'new continent' to which people will move. His message was clear: if the Church does not come to that continent with the proclamation of the Gospel, someone else will proclaim their 'gospel', which perhaps will not be Jesus's. This realization was a key confirmation for the idea of 'e-spiritual exercises'.

Fra Josip emphasizes that, although the internet can be a source of temptation, people are there, on social networks. Therefore, the presence of the Church in that digital space is necessary, with caution that authenticity is not lost. The goal is to proclaim Jesus as Savior and the good news of salvation, using modern methods to reach as many people as possible.

sections.subtitle: Sadržaj i tim aplikacije 'e-duhovne vježbe': Volonterski rad za duhovni rast
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip Vlašić predstavlja sadržaj aplikacije 'e-duhovne vježbe' i tim volontera koji je razvija.
sections.content:
Aplikacija 'e-duhovne vježbe' osmišljena je kako bi pomogla ljudima u molitvi i uvođenju u dublji duhovni život. Glavni sadržaj čine duhovne vježbe za ključna liturgijska razdoblja poput **Korizme** i **Došašća**, te dodatni ciklusi za **Duhove** i uoči **svetkovine sv. Franje**. Svi prethodno objavljeni ciklusi dostupni su korisnicima, stvarajući bogatu riznicu duhovnih materijala.

Posebno popularan sadržaj je 'Efa riječi', kratka dnevna razmatranja Božje riječi iz Evanđelja, koja služe kao duhovna hrana za početak dana. Aplikacija također nudi dnevna misna čitanja, preuzeta uz suglasnost **Hrvatskog instituta za liturgijski pastoral (HILP)**, što je, prema Fra Josipu, iznimno važno za hranjenje Božjom riječju. Osim toga, aplikacija sadrži svjedočanstva i novosti.

Projekt se oslanja na predani rad volonterskog tima. Jezgru čine fratri iz Pazina: **Fra Josip Vlašić**, **Fra Darko Tepert** (trenutno u Rimu) i **Fra Marinko Klajč** (sada biskupijski pustinjak). Ključna tehnička podrška je **Vlado Rosančić**, programer iz Franjevačkog svjetovnog reda, koji koordinira razvoj projekta s drugim programerima poput **Petra Čurkovića** i **Daniela Vincijanovića**. Za jezičnu dotjeranost tekstova brinu lektori **Marija Štancl** i **Miroslav Paulić**. Audio verzije razmatranja snima tim koji čine **Dijana Tikvić, Ana Marija Buntić, Loreta Rabar, Branimir Gubić, Jozo Lukić** i **Mihajl Vrbanić**, dok su za montažu zaduženi **Luka Rupčić** i Mihajl Vrbanić. U pisanju 'Efe riječi' sudjeluju i **Fra Nikola Juršić, Fra Marko, Stjepan Lice, Fra Željko Barbarić** i **sestra Sunčica Kunić**.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom o važnosti duhovnih vježbi i apostolatu laika.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče duhovne vježbe kao sredstvo obnove i produbljenja vjere, a volonterski rad laika u službi evangelizacije prepoznaje kao važan karizmatski doprinos izgradnji Crkve.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is fully aligned with Catholic teaching on the importance of spiritual retreats and the apostolate of the laity.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages spiritual exercises as a means of renewal and deepening of faith, and recognizes the volunteer work of the laity in the service of evangelization as an important charismatic contribution to the building up of the Church.

sections.subtitle_en: Content and team of the application 'e-duhovne vježbe': Volunteer work for spiritual growth
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip Vlašić presents the content of the application 'e-duhovne vježbe' and the team of volunteers that is developing it.
sections.content_en:
The application 'e-duhovne vježbe' is designed to help people in prayer and introduction into a deeper spiritual life. The main content consists of spiritual exercises for key liturgical seasons such as **Lent** and **Advent**, and additional cycles for **Pentecost** and on the eve of the **solemnity of Saint Francis**. All previously published cycles are available to users, creating a rich treasury of spiritual materials.

Particularly popular content is 'Efa riječi', short daily reflections on the Word of God from the Gospel, which serve as spiritual food for the beginning of the day. The application also offers daily Mass readings, taken with the consent of the **Hrvatski institut za liturgijski pastoral (HILP)**, which is, according to Fra Josip, extremely important for feeding on the Word of God. In addition, the application contains testimonies and news.

The project relies on the dedicated work of a volunteer team. The core consists of friars from Pazin: **Fra Josip Vlašić**, **Fra Darko Tepert** (currently in Rim) and **Fra Marinko Klajč** (now a diocesan hermit). Key technical support is **Vlado Rosančić**, a programmer from the Franjevački svjetovni red, who coordinates the development of the project with other programmers like **Petar Čurković** and **Daniel Vincijanović**. The proofreaders **Marija Štancl** and **Miroslav Paulić** take care of the linguistic refinement of the texts. Audio versions of the reflections are recorded by a team consisting of **Dijana Tikvić, Ana Marija Buntić, Loreta Rabar, Branimir Gubić, Jozo Lukić** and **Mihajl Vrbanić**, while **Luka Rupčić** and Mihajl Vrbanić are in charge of editing. In the writing of 'Efa riječi', **Fra Nikola Juršić, Fra Marko, Stjepan Lice, Fra Željko Barbarić** and **sister Sunčica Kunić** also participate.

sections.subtitle: Franjevački svjetovni red (OFS): Život Evanđelja u svijetu
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip Vlašić objašnjava ulogu duhovnog asistenta i Franjevačkog svjetovnog reda (OFS).
sections.content:
Fra Josip Vlašić s velikom ljubavlju govori o svojoj službi duhovnog asistenta Franjevačkog svjetovnog reda (OFS) u Bosni i Hercegovini. Njegovo iskustvo započelo je 2010. godine u Mostaru, gdje je, unatoč nedostatku prethodnog iskustva s OFS-om, preuzeo ulogu područnog duhovnog asistenta i mjesnog bratstva. Danas je nacionalni duhovni asistent, ističući prirodnu povezanost s laicima.

Objašnjava da je **sveti Franjo** osnovao tri reda: Prvi red (braća franjevci), Drugi red (sestre klarise, kontemplativne redovnice) i Treći red (Franjevački svjetovni red). Članovi OFS-a su muškarci i žene koji žive u svijetu, prihvaćajući nadahnuće svetog Franje i živeći po Pravilu koje je odobrio **papa Pavao VI.** 1978. godine. OFS je strukturiran kao red, s vlastitim vrhovnim poglavarom, a trenutno je to **Tibor Kauser** iz Mađarske.

Uloga duhovnog asistenta je ključna: fratri brinu o vjernosti OFS-a franjevačkoj karizmi. Oni su garant da svjetovni franjevci žive autentično prema svom pozivu, čuvajući tu milost i Božji dar Crkvi i svijetu. Misija OFS-a je 'iz Evanđelja u život i iz života u Evanđelje', što znači živjeti Evanđelje u svom svakodnevnom staležu.

magisterium.assessment: Točan i precizan prikaz strukture franjevačke obitelji i Franjevačkog svjetovnog reda.
magisterium.enrichment: Franjevački svjetovni red (OFS) ima dugu povijest i pravno je priznat kao dio franjevačke obitelji, omogućujući laicima da žive evanđeosko savršenstvo u svijetu.
magisterium.assessment_en: An accurate and precise presentation of the structure of the Franciscan family and the Secular Franciscan Order.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Secular Franciscan Order (OFS) has a long history and is legally recognized as part of the Franciscan family, enabling laypeople to live evangelical perfection in the world.

sections.subtitle_en: Secular Franciscan Order (OFS): Life of the Gospel in the world
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip Vlašić explains the role of the spiritual assistant and the Secular Franciscan Order (OFS).
sections.content_en:
Fra Josip Vlašić speaks with great love about his ministry of spiritual assistant of the Secular Franciscan Order (OFS) in Bosna i Hercegovina. His experience began in the year 2010 in Mostar, where, despite the lack of previous experience with OFS, he took over the role of regional spiritual assistant and of the local fraternity. Today he is the national spiritual assistant, emphasizing the natural connection with the laity.

He explains that **Saint Francis** founded three orders: the First Order (Franciscan brothers), the Second Order (Poor Clare sisters, contemplative nuns), and the Third Order (Secular Franciscan Order). Members of OFS are men and women who live in the world, accepting the inspiration of Saint Francis and living according to the Rule approved by **Pope Paul VI** in the year 1978. OFS is structured as an order, with its own supreme head, and currently it is **Tibor Kauser** from Mađarska.

The role of the spiritual assistant is crucial: the friars care for the fidelity of OFS to the Franciscan charism. They are the guarantee that secular Franciscans live authentically according to their vocation, preserving this grace and God's gift to the Church and the world. The mission of OFS is 'from Gospel to life and from life to Gospel', which means living the Gospel in one's everyday state of life.

sections.subtitle: Privlačenje mladih u OFS: Autentičnost iznad predrasuda
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip Vlašić razgovara o privlačenju mladih u Franjevački svjetovni red i prevladavanju predrasuda.
sections.content:
Marija postavlja pitanje o privlačenju mladih u Franjevački svjetovni red (OFS), s obzirom na čestu predrasudu da je to zajednica uglavnom za starije osobe. Fra Josip Vlašić, koji je i sam radio s mladima kao asistent Frame, priznaje da takve predrasude postoje, ali naglašava da poziv ne poznaje dobne granice.

Objašnjava da OFS nije samo molitvena zajednica, već red koji zahtijeva ozbiljnu formaciju, uključujući simpatizerstvo, novicijat (do dvije godine) i privremene zavjete, prije nego što se polože doživotni, trajni zavjeti. Ta trajna obveza može biti prepreka za neke mlade. Ipak, Fra Josip ističe da je OFS provjeren put, star 800 godina, koji nudi duboku, ali jednostavnu duhovnost. Obveze uključuju molitvu časoslova i život u bratstvu.

Umjesto forsiranja mladih da se pridruže, Fra Josip naglašava važnost **autentičnosti** franjevačkog života. Vjeruje da će dobar i vjerodostojan život franjevaca, ispunjen Kristom i bratskom ljubavlju, sam po sebi privući one koje Duh Sveti nadahnjuje. 'Život svakog brata je ili promocija ili sablazan', kaže Fra Josip, sugerirajući da je najbolja 'promocija' duhovnih zvanja upravo primjerom. Ako život u OFS-u oblikuje čovjeka u dobrog kršćanina, tada nije potrebno nikoga posebno nagovarati.

magisterium.assessment: Ispravno naglašava da je poziv na svetost i franjevačku karizmu univerzalan i nije ograničen dobi.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva naučava da su svi vjernici pozvani na svetost, a autentično življenje karizme privlači ljude svih generacija jer odgovara na duboku ljudsku čežnju za Bogom.
magisterium.assessment_en: It correctly emphasizes that the call to holiness and the Franciscan charism is universal and is not limited by age.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church teaches that all believers are called to holiness, and the authentic living of the charism attracts people of all generations because it responds to the deep human longing for God.

sections.subtitle_en: Attracting youth to the OFS: Authenticity above prejudices
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip Vlašić talks about attracting young people into the Secular Franciscan Order and overcoming prejudices.
sections.content_en: Marija asks a question about attracting young people to the Secular Franciscan Order (OFS), considering the frequent prejudice that it is a community mainly for older people. Fra Josip Vlašić, who himself worked with young people as an assistant of Frama, admits that such prejudices exist, but emphasizes that the vocation does not know age limits. He explains that OFS is not only a prayer community, but an order that requires serious formation, including sympathizership, novitiate (up to two years) and temporary vows, before lifelong, permanent vows are professed. This permanent commitment can be an obstacle for some young people. Nevertheless, Fra Josip points out that OFS is a proven path, 800 years old, which offers a deep but simple spirituality. Obligations include the prayer of the Liturgy of the Hours and life in fraternity. Instead of forcing young people to join, Fra Josip emphasizes the importance of the **authenticity** of Franciscan life. He believes that a good and credible life of Franciscans, filled with Christ and brotherly love, will by itself attract those whom the Holy Spirit inspires. 'The life of every brother is either a promotion or a scandal', says Fra Josip, suggesting that the best 'promotion' of spiritual vocations is precisely by example. If life in the OFS shapes a person into a good Christian, then it is not necessary to specially persuade anyone.

sections.subtitle: OFS i karizmatske zajednice: Jedinstvo u različitosti Crkve
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip Vlašić govori o odnosu Franjevačkog svjetovnog reda i karizmatskih zajednica.
sections.content:
Fra Josip Vlašić razmatra odnos između Franjevačkog svjetovnog reda (OFS) i karizmatskih zajednica, odbacujući ideju da je OFS 'u sjeni' novijih pokreta. Ističe da svaki pokret u Crkvi ima svoj put, razvojne faze i dinamiku rasta, a Duh Sveti podiže ono što je potrebno Crkvi i svijetu. Važno je da se u svemu slavi Krist, bez obzira radi li se o franjevačkom redu, karizmatskim ili kontemplativnim zajednicama.

Ključna je svijest o **jedinstvu u različitosti**: svi smo jedno tijelo s mnogo udova. Fra Josip upozorava na isključivost, koja je 'znak da tu nešto smrdi' i nije od Boga. Citira papu Lava (Leona) XIII. i njegovo geslo 'In Illo Unum' (U Njemu smo jedno), naglašavajući da smo svi jedno u Kristu. Svi su važni i vrijedni, i za sve ima mjesta u Crkvi.

Međutim, Fra Josip pojašnjava da nije moguće biti trajno član i Franjevačkog svjetovnog reda i karizmatske zajednice. Iako je zajedničarenje i povremeno sudjelovanje u aktivnostima drugih zajednica dobrodošlo, trajna pripadnost zahtijeva cjelovito predanje jednoj duhovnosti i formaciji. Čovjek ne može 'pripadati na sve strane' jer bi to dovelo do nedostatka cjelovitosti. Svaki poziv, bilo da je to franjevački ili karizmatski, ima svoje specifične obveze i put, za koje će se odgovarati pred Bogom. Fra Josip zaključuje da se čovjek ima pravo tražiti, ali to traženje mora prestati i dovesti do opredjeljenja.

magisterium.assessment: Ispravno promiče jedinstvo u različitosti, što je temeljno načelo crkvene ekleziologije.
magisterium.enrichment: Duh Sveti daruje različite karizme za dobrobit cijele Crkve; stoga je suradnja i međusobno poštovanje između tradicionalnih redova i novih pokreta ključno za misijsko poslanje Crkve.
magisterium.assessment_en: It correctly promotes unity in diversity, which is a fundamental principle of church ecclesiology.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Holy Spirit gives different charisms for the benefit of the entire Church; therefore, cooperation and mutual respect between traditional orders and new movements is crucial for the missionary mission of the Church.

sections.subtitle_en: OFS and charismatic communities: Unity in the diversity of the Church
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip Vlašić speaks about the relationship between the Secular Franciscan Order and charismatic communities.
sections.content_en:
Fra Josip Vlašić reflects on the relationship between the Secular Franciscan Order (OFS) and charismatic communities, rejecting the idea that the OFS is 'in the shadow' of newer movements. He emphasizes that every movement in the Church has its own path, developmental phases, and dynamics of growth, and the Holy Spirit raises up what is needed by the Church and the world. It is important that Christ is glorified in everything, regardless of whether it is about the Franciscan order, charismatic, or contemplative communities.

The awareness of **unity in diversity** is key: we are all one body with many members. Fra Josip warns against exclusivity, which is 'a sign that something stinks there' and is not from God. He quotes Pope Leo (Leo) XIII and his motto 'In Illo Unum' (In Him we are one), emphasizing that we are all one in Christ. Everyone is important and valuable, and there is room for everyone in the Church.

However, Fra Josip clarifies that it is not possible to permanently be a member of both the Secular Franciscan Order and a charismatic community. Although fellowship and occasional participation in the activities of other communities is welcome, permanent belonging requires complete surrender to one spirituality and formation. A person cannot 'belong to all sides' because that would lead to a lack of completeness. Every calling, whether it is Franciscan or charismatic, has its own specific obligations and path, for which one will answer before God. Fra Josip concludes that a person has the right to search, but this searching must stop and lead to a commitment.

sections.subtitle: Završna poruka: Čeznite i molite
sections.screenshot_description: Fra Josip Vlašić upućuje završnu poruku gledateljima o važnosti molitve i čežnje za Bogom.
sections.content:
Na kraju razgovora, Fra Josip Vlašić upućuje snažnu završnu poruku gledateljima, inspiriranu riječima **Ivana Pavla II.**: 'Moli kako god znaš, samo moli.' Međutim, Fra Josip dodaje svoju ključnu misao: 'Čezni za Bogom, ljubi Boga.'

Objašnjava da ako se molitva, bez obzira je li usmena, misaona ili molitva šutnje, rađa iz iskrene **čežnje za Bogom**, ona će uvijek biti dobra. Njegova poruka je poziv na duboku duhovnu povezanost: 'Molite, čeznući i čeznite, moleći.' Time naglašava da molitva nije samo ritual ili obveza, već izraz unutarnje ljubavi i težnje prema Stvoritelju, što je temelj autentičnog duhovnog života.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom jer naglašava važnost molitve kao temeljne potrebe duše i potiče na iskrenu čežnju za Bogom, što je srž kršćanskog života.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička tradicija uči da je molitva 'uzdizanje duše k Bogu' (KKK 2098) i da je žeđ za Bogom duboko ukorijenjena u ljudskom srcu (KKK 2557). Iako je važno učiti kako moliti kroz predaju Crkve (KKK 2650), iskrena nakana i čežnja za Bogom su primarni pokretači autentičnog duhovnog života.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is completely aligned with Catholic teaching because it emphasizes the importance of prayer as a fundamental need of the soul and encourages a sincere longing for God, which is the core of Christian life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic tradition teaches that prayer is the 'raising of the soul to God' (CCC 2098) and that the thirst for God is deeply rooted in the human heart (CCC 2557). Although it is important to learn how to pray through the Tradition of the Church (CCC 2650), sincere intention and longing for God are the primary drivers of an authentic spiritual life.

sections.subtitle_en: Final message: Yearn and pray
sections.screenshot_description_en: Fra Josip Vlašić sends a final message to the viewers about the importance of prayer and longing for God.
sections.content_en:
At the end of the conversation, Fra Josip Vlašić addresses a powerful final message to the viewers, inspired by the words of **Ivan Pavao II.**: 'Pray however you know how, just pray.' However, Fra Josip adds his key thought: 'Long for God, love God.'

He explains that if prayer, regardless of whether it is vocal, mental, or a prayer of silence, is born from a sincere **longing for God**, it will always be good. His message is a call to a deep spiritual connection: 'Pray, longing, and long, praying.' With this, he emphasizes that prayer is not just a ritual or an obligation, but an expression of inner love and striving towards the Creator, which is the foundation of an authentic spiritual life.
